name: house/zoom-in-shape
title: Zoom inside shape
desc_vi: Ảnh luôn chuyển động: phóng chậm từ 1 lên 1,06 bên trong khung hình của nó, viền không nhúc nhích.
params_vi: to: scale cuối (1.06) · dur: giây (12) · origin · mask: ảnh khác làm cửa sổ (null = chính ảnh)
notes: Port of P.zoomInShape. The container is masked by the picture's alpha (CSS mask-image, written into its style); the zoom is a ctx.code proxy tween 0 -> 1 over dur with ease none, so it holds at 1 before `at` and at `to` after. Demo picture is a generated arch with a pattern; the demo zooms to 1.12 for visibility. In After Effects the mask becomes an alpha track matte.
